method.decoder: OpenCV VideoCapture video only; no audio access
method.alignment: Seek derivative to each requested elapsed time, then seek source to decoded derivative PTS; record both decoded PTS. No image-content alignment or best-frame selection.
method.reference_geometry: Source decoded BGR frame resized with cv2.INTER_AREA only if needed to match actual prepared geometry. No resize when already equal.
method.psnr: 10*log10(255^2 / mean squared BGR difference), all pixels/channels
method.ssim: Grayscale OpenCV conversion; standard Gaussian11x11 sigma1.5 local population moments, K1=.01,K2=.03,L=255; discard5px border and average SSIM map. Implemented using NumPy/OpenCV because scikit-image absent.
method.gradient: Mean 3x3 Sobel gradient magnitude of prepared/reference grayscale; ratio near1 indicates similar aggregate edge energy, not semantic detail preservation.

limitations: Metrics are conditional on the prepared1280-long-edge geometry; intentional high-resolution information loss is not measured.
Three samples per video do not verify every frame or event; numerical similarity cannot guarantee cash/action details remain identifiable.
Nearest timestamp alignment is approximate; temporal resampling phase, motion and different downsampling kernels contribute to measured differences.
No footage, individual identities, OCR, audio or semantic model observations were emitted or inspected by the assistant.
